newsitem.title: USA: COMEX to narrow strike prices for gold options.
newsitem.headline: COMEX to narrow strike prices for gold options.

text.p: The New York Mercantile Exchange will narrow the strike price increments for the first three months of gold trading in its COMEX division, beginning on Monday, January 13, an exchange spokeswoman said Friday.
There are six strike prices initially listed above and below the at-the-money price in COMEX gold options.
Increments for strike prices at $500.00 an ounce or below, which in all other months will remain $10.00 an ounce apart, will become $5.00 an ounce in the first three months, the exchange said.

Increments for strike prices greater than $500 and less than $1,000 will change from $20 to $10 in the first three months and increments for strike prices more than $1,000 for those months will be $25, instead of $50.
